bug_locations: clamp: missing required validation that raises ValueError when low > high
clamp: abnormal indentation of the return statement normalized to standard 4-space indentation
explanation: The min/max logic correctly bounds x inclusively, but the function never validates the bounds. Per the spec, clamp must raise ValueError when low > high; the original silently returned a nonsensical result (e.g., clamp(5, 10, 0) returned 10). The fix adds an explicit low > high check that raises ValueError before computing the clamped value, and normalizes the odd 17-space indentation of the return statement to a standard 4-space block.
